limits: Exact compounds mean pinned source element membership, not anatomical or clinical completeness.
IS-A class projection uses native concept IDs; same FJ identifier across releases is insufficient.

Source labels and geometry remain unchanged. 17 pinned 4.3i source files are restored; 16 versioned identities reuse byte-identical resident geometry. Historical holds are retained separately from current resolution. Two table-backed 4.0 export omissions are restored.
Multiple source identities can share one physical span, and a source identity can occur in multiple owners.

Recovered 4.3i concepts use complete pinned OBJ Concept ID membership; no new 4.3i system hierarchy or cross-version equivalence is asserted. Exact noncoincidence does not establish anatomical independence of alternative surfaces.
